info.text:
How we build a YouTube video in three days or less, with Alex approving every step.

Our first long walkthrough, "Test your website with one key", is on our YouTube channel. Here is how it was made, shown with our real files:

1. Before day 1: a plan and a brief. The topic, the page it links to, the playlist and a three-day schedule are written down, and Alex approves them before anything is made.
2. Day 1: screen captures, voice and music. Every good example is our own site; every bad one is a plain test page we built for the video. The voice is AI narrated, one file per beat, and every take is checked word for word against the script.
3. Day 2: the edit. Style frames first, then the cut, with our logo and web address on every frame.
4. Day 3: render and approval. Alex watches the finished video on our Post Desk, answers the open questions and approves it. Only then is it scheduled.

No client data appears in the video, and its description says the voice is AI narrated.

Full walkthrough on our YouTube channel: https://www.youtube.com/@KAPerformancefl

#SmallBusiness #VideoProduction #GainesvilleFL
